articles.title: Supply of 40 Airbus aircraft to Defence Ministry taxable; AAR says Gujarat GST registration required
articles.summary: The Gujarat Authority for Advance Rulings (AAR) has ruled that Airbus must obtain GST registration in Gujarat to supply aircraft to India's Defence Ministry. This decision is crucial as a Tata group company is assembling these aircraft in Gujarat for Airbus, underscoring the tax compliance requirements for major defence procurement deals involving domestic manufacturing within India.
